*Date and location TBC — BioSyst EU 2026, Uppsala University, 17–19 August 2026*

- **Introduction** (10 min)
  - Overview of SBDI and GBIF
  - eDNA tools and workflows in SBDI<br><br>

- **From raw reads to ASVs** (10 min)
  - Denoising and taxonomic annotation with nf-core/ampliseq<br><br>

- **Data sharing and access in SBDI** (10 min)
  - Metabarcoding data submission to ENA
  - Submission, discovery and download in the ASV portal
  - Processing ASV portal downloads with asvoccur<br><br>

- **Hands-on tutorial: Import and analyse ASV portal data with R** (55 min)
  - Integrate ASV portal data with asvoccur
  - Explore arthropod biodiversity patterns across habitat types<br><br>

- **Wrap-up** (5 min)
  - Key takeaways
  - Support and next steps
